result.description: Collaboration suite (messaging, docs, calendar, approval, base) with an Open Platform REST API for building bots and apps.
result.auth_detail: App ID + App Secret exchanged for app_access_token or tenant_access_token (about 2h, sent as Bearer). user_access_token comes from an OAuth2 authorization-code flow with a configured redirect URL. Store apps also need app_ticket pushes.
result.access_detail: Custom apps are self-serve but work in one tenant only. Each new version and scope change needs approval from that tenant's admin. Serving other customers' tenants needs a store app, listed in the App Center and built by an ISV. I did not fetch the store listing review page. I found no plan or pricing restriction on API access, but I did not confirm there is none. The Lark-domain app-type pages returned no content, so the app-type and review quotes come from the Feishu China docs. Lark may differ.
result.api_notes: Large REST surface at open.larksuite.com/open-apis (im, bitable, approval, calendar, docs, contacts and more). Event subscriptions can use WebSocket. Official SDKs are available.
result.blocker: Multi-tenant OAuth for other customers' workspaces needs a store app (ISV listing and review). Without it, each customer must create a custom app and supply their own App ID and Secret, and their admin must approve the scopes.

evidence.quote: 获取 user_access_token 的方式同时适用于企业自建应用和商店应用。
user_access_token 的有效期为两小时左右，过期后，需要刷新后再使用。
企业自建应用：由企业内部人员或企业授权的开发人员进行开发，只能在同一企业内发布和使用。
商店应用：由第三方服务商开发，在飞书应用中心发布，所有飞书企业均可安装和使用。
都需要发布新的应用版本，并且通过企业管理员的审核后才能生效。
